lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
LeBlanc gives update on U.S. trade talks to Canada-U.S. advisory committee, The Canadian Press reports.
The federal government is increasing its investment in the 2028 North American Indigenous Games by $1.3M, bringing its total contribution to $6.2M, The Canadian Press reports.
Inside the historic summit between Trump, Xi and Putin, PBS NewsHour reports.
The Trump administration on Thursday moved to effectively drop its lawsuit that sought to block the certification of Democrat Mary Peltola’s victory in Alaska’s U.S, The Associated Press reports.
Sanders pours cold water on 2028 White House bid, The Hill reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
